name: Slayers' Living Space
desc:
Fight monsters, earn Money, and build your dream home!

💰 Use Money in the Shop to buy:
• Powerful Swords
• Cool Skills
• Extra Health

🪑 Buy furniture from the Market to decorate your home.
🌙 Stronger monsters appear at night — be ready!
⚔️ Feeling strong? Raid other players’ homes and prove your power!

👍 Like the game to support future updates!

“Prayer in Islam, along with healthy eating and daily exercise, brings deep and lasting happiness in this life. And when death comes, it leads to Paradise.
Abandoning prayer and following desires, however, brings profound misery in this world, and upon death leads to Hell — a wretched destiny.
Both paths have been tried in this life: happiness was found in the first, and sorrow in the second.”, SEE COMMUNITY ANNOUNCEMENT
